tools.name: get_project_red_record
tools.description: Monthly wellhead temperature (degF) and produced and injected volumes of Fervo Energy's Project Red well pair in Nevada, from the state regulator. Use for questions about Project Red cooling, Fervo's operating data or enhanced geothermal decline.

tools.name: get_project_red_forecast
tools.description: Zemanium's forecast of Project Red's monthly wellhead temperature to December 2027 (median and p10 to p90 band), registered and time-stamped on 19 November 2026. Use to compare new regulator months against a forecast made before they existed.

tools.name: get_nevada_plant_output
tools.description: Electricity produced per year (MWh) by each geothermal power plant in Nevada since 2009, and the state total, from the Nevada Division of Minerals. Use for fleet trends or one plant's output.

tools.name: get_nevada_field_temperature
tools.description: Flow-weighted mean production temperature per year (degF) for each Nevada geothermal field, with operator of record. Use to check whether a geothermal reservoir is cooling or whether geothermal energy is sustainable in practice.

tools.name: get_geothermal_cost_cases
tools.description: Simulated levelized cost of electricity (USD per MWh) for 25 geothermal plant cases run in GEOPHIRES 3.18.3, by reservoir temperature, flow per well and well diameter. Use for geothermal LCOE questions.
